reviews.body: This dress is so lovely and flattering! I was invited to an awards lunch at work with only two days to prepare. I (dangerously-do not recommend) “shopped” for my dress on my way to work (traffic was a snails pace so I wasn’t moving much - don’t judge me 😬) and prayed it would arrive on time and look decent. I was so pleasantly surprised by the quality of the fabric and cut, it fits perfectly which is tough with my petite, athletic but curvy build. I normally wear a size 2-4 but because I have broad shoulders and no time to pivot I sized to a 4. It fits well now with room to grow, and because it’s a timeless wardrobe staple I can see wearing it forever. I love the lightly puffed sleeves and the gold zipper is classy but makes a statement. One of my favorite pieces, made more so by how poorly it could have gone with so little time.

I needed a dress for my mother's memorial service and this was perfect! I am 5'7, 140 lbs with an athletic build. I ordered my regular dress size of a 4 and it fit like it was made for me. It is so flattering and I received so many complements. It is also extremely comfortable! The fabric has a little bit of stretch, and is a nice weight for a fall or spring occasion. The higher neck and knee length make it an appropriate option for church. I want to say I wish it had pockets, but the fact it doesn't have pockets elevates its class. For the versatility of this dress I feel it has a great value.
Love the dress, looks very nice on. Great quality!!

products.search_term: Calvin Klein Long Sleeve Rib Mini Dress

reviews.title: Gorgeous dress
reviews.body: I absolutely love this Calvin Klein long sleeve surplice wrap mini dress! The color is gorgeous in person rich, flattering, and exactly as shown. The quality really stands out for the price; the fabric feels well-made, smooth, and comfortable to wear all day or night. The fit is true to size, and the wrap style with the buckle is super flattering and elegant. It hugs in the right places without feeling tight, and the comfort level is amazing. Definitely great value for money I’ve gotten so many compliments already. Highly recommend! 💖
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 8, 2026
reviews.author: Michael K

reviews.title: I must have staple for your closet!
reviews.body:
This Calvin Klein long sleeve surplice wrap mini dress is absolutely stunning and very flattering. The wrap style with the buckle detail cinches the waist beautifully and creates a sleek, polished silhouette. It’s the perfect balance of classy and sexy.

I ordered a size 4 in black, and the fit is spot on...tailored without feeling tight. The fabric feels high quality, smooth, and comfortable, with just enough structure to hold its shape. The long sleeves add elegance, making it great for cooler weather, work events, dinners, or nights out.

This dress looks sophisticated and timeless, exactly what you’d expect from Calvin Klein. It’s easy to style with heels or boots and instantly makes you feel put-together and confident. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a chic, versatile statement dress! Worth every penny!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 29, 2026
reviews.author: Jenn

reviews.title: Classic flattering style, but thin material
reviews.body:
Finally slipped into this casual holiday dress for an afterwork end of year event. Black velvet drape is a timeless classic: dressy enough for candlelight dinners, casual cocktails, and still modest enough for family gatherings or school recitals.
For the price and designer label, I anticipated a much thicker, heavier velvet material. It’s not as well made as the price implies, so the thinner, stretchier style of this business casual dress is underwhelming. The fit is true to size at least, but cannot be tightened or loosened at the clasp since it zips in the back. Although it has a wrap dress design, the dress is not a true wrap dress.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 11, 2025
reviews.author: Fit PharmKat

Calvin Klein Smooth Mini Polo Sweatshirt Dress
Calvin Klein Smooth Sleeveless Mini Dress

reviews.body: Love the classic style and the fit of this dress. The tweed fabric is very soft and the collar addsa nice updated touch. This dress is easy to style, the black and white can carry you through all seasons, sleeveless for the summer with nice sandals and you can add a sweater or blazer for colder weather. Very appropriate for a business meeting, church or any occasion where you need a more conservative style. A nice pair of pearl earrings to give it a higher end look, or a pair of red heels and a bag, it's so pretty you don't need much to make this dress pop. Very well constructed dress, the cut is very flattering. Love the contrasting white color of the neck. Excellent value.

I love this dress so much, and if I could give it more stars, I would! Calvin Klein dresses have been some of my favorite work dresses. They always look perfectly tailored and structured. This dress is a perfect example of that. It fits like a glove and is made of very high quality materials that will last a long time if cared for properly. I love the tweed material, which in this case is soft and not scratchy. It is lightweight and breathable with just the right amount of stretch. The zipper was smooth and didn't catch on the material at all. The pockets in the front are more like one long pocket, they are not separated, but accessible from either side, almost like a hand warmer. The collar gives it that perfect retro chic but polished look. For reference, I am wearing a size 2 and I am 5'5" amd 114 lbs. Highly recommend!

I got this well-made, versatile dress for my daughter, and she looks lovely in it. You could easily style it up or down and she says it is quite comfortable. The cut is flattering and it seems to fit true to size. However, we're not so sure about the hoodie-style front pocket. While it seems cute and convenient, it doesn't lay perfectly flat and is visible in the most unfortunate way (almost like she's wearing bulky underwear). Also, she stepped into the dress and nearly got her foot caught in the pocket as it isn't attached to the dress at the top. At the time of this review, this dress is selling for more than $115. I don't know that I think the value is there at that price point.
